triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER job_chunk_completion_fence_trigger BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF chunk_state, attempt_number, fencing_token, output_sha256, started_at, completed_at, rows_read, rows_written, rows_rejected ON v3_async.job_chunk FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_async.enforce_job_chunk_completion_fence()

functions.name: enforce_job_chunk_completion_fence
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_async.enforce_job_chunk_completion_fence()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
    IF TG_OP = 'UPDATE'
       AND OLD.chunk_state IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'QUARANTINED') THEN
        IF NEW.chunk_state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.chunk_state
           AND NEW.attempt_number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.attempt_number
           AND NEW.fencing_token IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.fencing_token
           AND NEW.output_sha256 IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.output_sha256
           AND NEW.started_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.started_at
           AND NEW.completed_at IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.completed_at
           AND NEW.rows_read IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.rows_read
           AND NEW.rows_written IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.rows_written
           AND NEW.rows_rejected IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.rows_rejected THEN
            -- Deliberately permit an exact idempotent/no-op retry only.
            RETURN NEW;
        END IF;

        RAISE EXCEPTION USING
            ERRCODE = '55000',
            MESSAGE = format(
                'terminal completion metadata is immutable for job %s chunk %s',
                NEW.job_id, NEW.chunk_key
            );
    END IF;

    IF NEW.chunk_state IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'QUARANTINED')
       AND (TG_OP = 'INSERT' OR
            OLD.chunk_state NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'FAILED', 'QUARANTINED')) THEN
        PERFORM 1
          FROM v3_async.job_lease lease
          JOIN v3_async.job job ON job.job_id = lease.job_id
         WHERE lease.job_id = NEW.job_id
           AND lease.fencing_token = NEW.fencing_token
           AND lease.acquired_at <= clock_timestamp()
           AND lease.expires_at > clock_timestamp()
           AND job.job_state = 'RUNNING'
         FOR UPDATE OF lease;
        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING
                ERRCODE = '55000',
                MESSAGE = format(
                    'stale, unknown, or expired completion fence for job %s token %s',
                    NEW.job_id, NEW.fencing_token
                );
        END IF;

        PERFORM 1
          FROM v3_async.job_attempt
         WHERE job_id = NEW.job_id
           AND attempt_number = NEW.attempt_number
           AND fencing_token = NEW.fencing_token
           AND attempt_state = 'RUNNING';
        IF NOT FOUND THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION USING
                ERRCODE = '55000',
                MESSAGE = format(
                    'unknown or inactive completion attempt for job %s attempt %s token %s',
                    NEW.job_id, NEW.attempt_number, NEW.fencing_token
                );
        END IF;
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

functions.name: create_canonical_generation_relations
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_meta.create_canonical_generation_relations(target_generation_id uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    target_schema text;
    target_state text;
BEGIN
    SELECT relation_schema, lifecycle_state
      INTO target_schema, target_state
      FROM v3_meta.canonical_generation
     WHERE generation_id = target_generation_id
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown canonical generation %', target_generation_id;
    END IF;
    IF target_state <> 'BUILDING' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'generation % is %, expected BUILDING', target_generation_id, target_state;
    END IF;
    IF target_schema !~ '^v3_gen_[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,30}$' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsafe generation schema %', target_schema;
    END IF;
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = target_schema) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'generation schema % already exists', target_schema;
    END IF;

    EXECUTE format('CREATE SCHEMA %I', target_schema);
    EXECUTE format('COMMENT ON SCHEMA %I IS %L', target_schema,
        'V3 canonical generation physical relations; immutable after publication.');

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.systems (
            id64 bigint NOT NULL,
            name text NOT NULL,
            x_ly double precision NOT NULL,
            y_ly double precision NOT NULL,
            z_ly double precision NOT NULL,
            source_body_count integer,
            loaded_body_count integer NOT NULL,
            galaxy_region_id smallint,
            grid_x integer NOT NULL,
            grid_y integer NOT NULL,
            grid_z integer NOT NULL,
            macro_grid_key bigint NOT NULL,
            source_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            source_updated_at timestamptz,
            freshness_checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
            lifecycle_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
            last_present_run_id uuid,
            last_present_at timestamptz,
            first_missing_run_id uuid,
            first_missing_at timestamptz,
            last_missing_run_id uuid,
            retired_at timestamptz,
            retired_reason text,
            CHECK (source_body_count IS NULL OR source_body_count >= 0),
            CHECK (loaded_body_count >= 0),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('ACTIVE', 'MISSING_CANDIDATE', 'RETIRED')),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state <> 'RETIRED' OR retired_at IS NOT NULL),
            CHECK ((first_missing_run_id IS NULL) = (first_missing_at IS NULL))
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.bodies (
            body_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            system_id64 bigint NOT NULL,
            source_body_id64 bigint,
            frontier_body_id bigint,
            direct_parent_body_pk bigint,
            name text NOT NULL,
            body_type_id smallint,
            atmosphere_classification_id smallint,
            terraforming_state_id smallint,
            volcanism_type_id smallint,
            is_landable boolean,
            is_tidally_locked boolean,
            is_main_star boolean,
            spectral_class text,
            luminosity_class text,
            absolute_magnitude double precision,
            radius_km double precision,
            planet_mass_earth double precision,
            stellar_mass_solar double precision,
            surface_gravity_g double precision,
            surface_pressure_atm double precision,
            surface_temperature_k double precision,
            semi_major_axis_km double precision,
            orbital_period_days double precision,
            rotation_period_days double precision,
            eccentricity double precision,
            orbital_inclination_deg double precision,
            ascending_node_deg double precision,
            argument_of_periapsis_deg double precision,
            mean_anomaly_deg double precision,
            axial_tilt_rad double precision,
            distance_from_arrival_ls double precision,
            stellar_age_myr double precision,
            signals_complete boolean,
            genera_complete boolean,
            source_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            source_updated_at timestamptz,
            freshness_checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
            lifecycle_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
            last_present_run_id uuid,
            last_present_at timestamptz,
            first_missing_run_id uuid,
            first_missing_at timestamptz,
            last_missing_run_id uuid,
            retired_at timestamptz,
            retired_reason text,
            CHECK (eccentricity IS NULL OR eccentricity BETWEEN 0 AND 1),
            CHECK (mean_anomaly_deg IS NULL OR
                (mean_anomaly_deg >= 0 AND mean_anomaly_deg <= 360)),
            CHECK (absolute_magnitude IS NULL OR absolute_magnitude NOT IN (
                'NaN'::double precision,
                'Infinity'::double precision,
                '-Infinity'::double precision
            )),
            CHECK (spectral_class IS NULL OR btrim(spectral_class) <> ''),
            CHECK (luminosity_class IS NULL OR btrim(luminosity_class) <> ''),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('ACTIVE', 'MISSING_CANDIDATE', 'RETIRED')),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state <> 'RETIRED' OR retired_at IS NOT NULL),
            CHECK ((first_missing_run_id IS NULL) = (first_missing_at IS NULL))
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.body_composition (
            body_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            ice_pct real,
            metal_pct real,
            rock_pct real,
            materials jsonb,
            materials_complete boolean,
            atmosphere jsonb,
            atmosphere_complete boolean,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz,
            CHECK (ice_pct IS NULL OR ice_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
            CHECK (metal_pct IS NULL OR metal_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
            CHECK (rock_pct IS NULL OR rock_pct BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
            CHECK ((materials IS NULL AND materials_complete IS NULL) OR
                (materials IS NOT NULL AND materials_complete IS NOT NULL AND
                 v3_meta.is_percentage_object(materials, materials_complete))),
            CHECK ((atmosphere IS NULL AND atmosphere_complete IS NULL) OR
                (atmosphere IS NOT NULL AND atmosphere_complete IS NOT NULL AND
                 v3_meta.is_percentage_object(atmosphere, atmosphere_complete))),
            CHECK (
                ice_pct IS NOT NULL OR metal_pct IS NOT NULL OR rock_pct IS NOT NULL
                OR materials IS NOT NULL OR atmosphere IS NOT NULL
            )
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.body_alias (
            body_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            identity_namespace_id smallint NOT NULL,
            external_id text NOT NULL,
            source_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.body_parent_evidence (
            body_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            system_id64 bigint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            source_parent_ordinal smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
            raw_parent_label text NOT NULL,
            raw_parent_id bigint,
            resolution_state text NOT NULL,
            resolved_parent_body_pk bigint,
            detail jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
            CHECK (source_parent_ordinal = 0),
            CHECK (resolution_state IN ('UNRESOLVED', 'RESOLVED', 'CONFLICT', 'INVALID')),
            CHECK ((resolution_state = 'RESOLVED') = (resolved_parent_body_pk IS NOT NULL)),
            CHECK (jsonb_typeof(detail) = 'object')
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.rings (
            ring_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            body_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            system_id64 bigint NOT NULL,
            source_ring_id64 bigint,
            kind text NOT NULL,
            name text NOT NULL,
            ring_type_id smallint,
            reserve_type_id smallint,
            inner_radius_km double precision,
            outer_radius_km double precision,
            mass_mt double precision,
            signals_complete boolean,
            source_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            source_updated_at timestamptz,
            freshness_checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
            lifecycle_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
            last_present_run_id uuid,
            last_present_at timestamptz,
            first_missing_run_id uuid,
            first_missing_at timestamptz,
            last_missing_run_id uuid,
            retired_at timestamptz,
            retired_reason text,
            CHECK (kind IN ('RING', 'BELT')),
            CHECK (inner_radius_km IS NULL OR inner_radius_km >= 0),
            CHECK (outer_radius_km IS NULL OR outer_radius_km >= 0),
            CHECK (inner_radius_km IS NULL OR outer_radius_km IS NULL OR outer_radius_km >= inner_radius_km),
            CHECK (mass_mt IS NULL OR mass_mt >= 0),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('ACTIVE', 'MISSING_CANDIDATE', 'RETIRED')),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state <> 'RETIRED' OR retired_at IS NOT NULL),
            CHECK ((first_missing_run_id IS NULL) = (first_missing_at IS NULL))
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.body_signal_current (
            body_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            signal_type_id smallint NOT NULL,
            signal_count integer NOT NULL CHECK (signal_count >= 0),
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.body_genus_current (
            body_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            genus_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.ring_signal_current (
            ring_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            signal_type_id smallint NOT NULL,
            signal_count integer NOT NULL CHECK (signal_count >= 0),
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.stations (
            station_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            market_id bigint,
            system_id64 bigint NOT NULL,
            name text NOT NULL,
            station_type_id smallint,
            distance_from_arrival_ls double precision,
            services_complete boolean,
            economies_complete boolean,
            is_fleet_carrier boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
            source_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            source_updated_at timestamptz,
            freshness_checked_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
            lifecycle_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
            last_present_run_id uuid,
            last_present_at timestamptz,
            first_missing_run_id uuid,
            first_missing_at timestamptz,
            last_missing_run_id uuid,
            retired_at timestamptz,
            retired_reason text,
            CHECK (distance_from_arrival_ls IS NULL OR distance_from_arrival_ls >= 0),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state IN ('ACTIVE', 'MISSING_CANDIDATE', 'RETIRED')),
            CHECK (lifecycle_state <> 'RETIRED' OR retired_at IS NOT NULL),
            CHECK ((first_missing_run_id IS NULL) = (first_missing_at IS NULL))
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.station_alias (
            station_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            identity_namespace_id smallint NOT NULL,
            external_id text NOT NULL,
            source_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.station_placement (
            station_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            system_id64 bigint NOT NULL,
            body_pk bigint,
            latitude_deg double precision,
            longitude_deg double precision,
            association_state text NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
            evidence_detail jsonb NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb,
            CHECK (latitude_deg IS NULL OR latitude_deg BETWEEN -90 AND 90),
            CHECK (longitude_deg IS NULL OR longitude_deg BETWEEN -180 AND 180),
            CHECK (association_state IN ('UNKNOWN', 'SYSTEM_ONLY', 'BODY_RESOLVED', 'CONFLICT', 'REJECTED')),
            CHECK (association_state <> 'BODY_RESOLVED' OR body_pk IS NOT NULL),
            CHECK (jsonb_typeof(evidence_detail) = 'object')
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.station_service_current (
            station_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            station_service_id smallint NOT NULL,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    EXECUTE format($ddl$
        CREATE TABLE %I.station_economy_current (
            station_pk bigint NOT NULL,
            economy_id smallint NOT NULL,
            economy_weight double precision,
            is_primary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
            is_secondary boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
            source_run_id uuid NOT NULL,
            observed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
            CHECK (economy_weight >= 0),
            CHECK (economy_weight NOT IN ('NaN'::double precision, 'Infinity'::double precision, '-Infinity'::double precision))
        )
    $ddl$, target_schema);

    UPDATE v3_meta.canonical_generation
       SET relations_created_at = transaction_timestamp()
     WHERE generation_id = target_generation_id;

    RETURN target_schema;
END;
$function$

functions.name: finalize_canonical_generation
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_meta.finalize_canonical_generation(target_generation_id uuid, receipt jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    target_schema text;
    target_state text;
    ddl text;
    missing_manifest_input boolean;
BEGIN
    SELECT relation_schema, lifecycle_state
      INTO target_schema, target_state
      FROM v3_meta.canonical_generation
     WHERE generation_id = target_generation_id
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown canonical generation %', target_generation_id;
    END IF;
    IF target_state <> 'BUILDING' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'generation % is %, expected BUILDING', target_generation_id, target_state;
    END IF;
    IF receipt IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(receipt) <> 'object' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'validation receipt must be a JSON object';
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = target_schema) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'generation schema % is missing', target_schema;
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM v3_meta.canonical_generation_input
         WHERE generation_id = target_generation_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'generation % has no input manifest', target_generation_id;
    END IF;
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
          FROM v3_meta.canonical_generation generation
          JOIN v3_meta.canonical_generation_input input
            ON input.generation_id = generation.generation_id
           AND input.source_run_id = generation.build_source_run_id
         WHERE generation.generation_id = target_generation_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'generation % build coordinator run is absent from its input manifest',
            target_generation_id;
    END IF;

    EXECUTE format($query$
        SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
              FROM (
                    SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.systems
                    UNION SELECT last_present_run_id FROM %1$I.systems
                    UNION SELECT first_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.systems
                    UNION SELECT last_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.systems
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.bodies
                    UNION SELECT last_present_run_id FROM %1$I.bodies
                    UNION SELECT first_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.bodies
                    UNION SELECT last_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.bodies
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.body_composition
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.body_alias
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.body_parent_evidence
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.rings
                    UNION SELECT last_present_run_id FROM %1$I.rings
                    UNION SELECT first_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.rings
                    UNION SELECT last_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.rings
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.body_signal_current
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.body_genus_current
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.ring_signal_current
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.stations
                    UNION SELECT last_present_run_id FROM %1$I.stations
                    UNION SELECT first_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.stations
                    UNION SELECT last_missing_run_id FROM %1$I.stations
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.station_alias
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.station_placement
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.station_service_current
                    UNION SELECT source_run_id FROM %1$I.station_economy_current
              ) used
              LEFT JOIN v3_meta.canonical_generation_input input
                ON input.generation_id = $1
               AND input.source_run_id = used.source_run_id
             WHERE used.source_run_id IS NOT NULL
               AND input.source_run_id IS NULL
        )
    $query$, target_schema)
    INTO missing_manifest_input
    USING target_generation_id;

    IF missing_manifest_input THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'generation % contains source runs absent from its input manifest',
            target_generation_id;
    END IF;

    UPDATE v3_meta.canonical_generation
       SET lifecycle_state = 'VALIDATING',
           validation_started_at = transaction_timestamp()
     WHERE generation_id = target_generation_id;

    -- Identity, FK-helper, and named serving indexes. No GIN/trigram indexes.
    FOREACH ddl IN ARRAY ARRAY[
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX systems_pk ON %I.systems(id64)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX systems_macro_grid_idx ON %I.systems(macro_grid_key,id64)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bodies_pk ON %I.bodies(body_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bodies_system_body_uidx ON %I.bodies(system_id64,body_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bodies_source_id64_uidx ON %I.bodies(source_body_id64) WHERE source_body_id64 IS NOT NULL', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bodies_frontier_body_uidx ON %I.bodies(system_id64,frontier_body_id) WHERE frontier_body_id IS NOT NULL', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX bodies_system_idx ON %I.bodies(system_id64,body_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX bodies_parent_idx ON %I.bodies(system_id64,direct_parent_body_pk) WHERE direct_parent_body_pk IS NOT NULL', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX body_composition_pk ON %I.body_composition(body_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX body_alias_identity_uidx ON %I.body_alias(identity_namespace_id,external_id)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX body_alias_body_idx ON %I.body_alias(body_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX body_parent_evidence_pk ON %I.body_parent_evidence(body_pk,source_run_id,source_parent_ordinal)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rings_pk ON %I.rings(ring_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rings_system_ring_uidx ON %I.rings(system_id64,ring_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rings_source_identity_uidx ON %I.rings(source_id,source_ring_id64) WHERE source_ring_id64 IS NOT NULL', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX rings_body_idx ON %I.rings(system_id64,body_pk,ring_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX body_signal_current_pk ON %I.body_signal_current(body_pk,signal_type_id)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX body_genus_current_pk ON %I.body_genus_current(body_pk,genus_id)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ring_signal_current_pk ON %I.ring_signal_current(ring_pk,signal_type_id)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stations_pk ON %I.stations(station_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stations_system_station_uidx ON %I.stations(system_id64,station_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stations_market_id_uidx ON %I.stations(market_id) WHERE market_id IS NOT NULL', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX stations_system_idx ON %I.stations(system_id64,station_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX station_alias_identity_uidx ON %I.station_alias(identity_namespace_id,external_id)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX station_alias_station_idx ON %I.station_alias(station_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX station_placement_pk ON %I.station_placement(station_pk)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE INDEX station_placement_body_idx ON %I.station_placement(system_id64,body_pk,station_pk) WHERE body_pk IS NOT NULL', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX station_service_current_pk ON %I.station_service_current(station_pk,station_service_id)', target_schema),
        format('CREATE UNIQUE INDEX station_economy_current_pk ON %I.station_economy_current(station_pk,economy_id)', target_schema)
    ] LOOP
        EXECUTE ddl;
    END LOOP;

    -- Query/use documentation for every non-integrity generation index.
    FOREACH ddl IN ARRAY ARRAY[
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.systems_macro_grid_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: bounded macro-grid system candidate scan.'),
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.bodies_system_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: list bodies for one system in stable body key order.'),
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.bodies_parent_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: list direct children for one same-system parent.'),
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.body_alias_body_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: list sparse additional identities for one body.'),
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.rings_body_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: list rings and belts for one body.'),
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.stations_system_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: list stations for one system in stable station key order.'),
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.station_alias_station_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: list sparse additional identities for one station.'),
        format('COMMENT ON INDEX %I.station_placement_body_idx IS %L', target_schema,
            'Use: list stations resolved to one body within a system.')
    ] LOOP
        EXECUTE ddl;
    END LOOP;

    FOREACH ddl IN ARRAY ARRAY[
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.systems ADD CONSTRAINT systems_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX systems_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.bodies ADD CONSTRAINT bodies_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX bodies_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.bodies ADD CONSTRAINT bodies_system_body_unique UNIQUE USING INDEX bodies_system_body_uidx', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.body_composition ADD CONSTRAINT body_composition_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX body_composition_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.body_alias ADD CONSTRAINT body_alias_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX body_alias_identity_uidx', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.body_parent_evidence ADD CONSTRAINT body_parent_evidence_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX body_parent_evidence_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.rings ADD CONSTRAINT rings_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX rings_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.rings ADD CONSTRAINT rings_system_ring_unique UNIQUE USING INDEX rings_system_ring_uidx', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.body_signal_current ADD CONSTRAINT body_signal_current_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX body_signal_current_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.body_genus_current ADD CONSTRAINT body_genus_current_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX body_genus_current_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.ring_signal_current ADD CONSTRAINT ring_signal_current_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX ring_signal_current_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.stations ADD CONSTRAINT stations_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX stations_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.stations ADD CONSTRAINT stations_system_station_unique UNIQUE USING INDEX stations_system_station_uidx', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.station_alias ADD CONSTRAINT station_alias_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX station_alias_identity_uidx', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.station_placement ADD CONSTRAINT station_placement_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX station_placement_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.station_service_current ADD CONSTRAINT station_service_current_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX station_service_current_pk', target_schema),
        format('ALTER TABLE %I.station_economy_current ADD CONSTRAINT station_economy_current_pk PRIMARY KEY USING INDEX station_economy_current_pk', target_schema)
    ] LOOP

functions.name: is_percentage_object
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_meta.is_percentage_object(value jsonb, is_complete boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS $function$
    WITH entries AS MATERIALIZED (
        SELECT entry.value
        FROM jsonb_each(
            CASE
                WHEN jsonb_typeof(value) = 'object' THEN value
                ELSE '{}'::jsonb
            END
        ) AS entry
    ), summary AS (
        SELECT
            count(*) AS entry_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(entries.value) = 'number') AS numeric_count,
            sum((entries.value #>> '{}')::numeric)
                FILTER (WHERE jsonb_typeof(entries.value) = 'number') AS total,
            bool_and(
                CASE
                    WHEN jsonb_typeof(entries.value) = 'number'
                    THEN (entries.value #>> '{}')::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 100
                    ELSE false
                END
            ) AS values_in_range
        FROM entries
    )
    SELECT
        jsonb_typeof(value) = 'object'
        AND entry_count > 0
        AND numeric_count = entry_count
        AND values_in_range
        AND (NOT is_complete OR abs(total - 100) <= 0.0001)
    FROM summary;
$function$
